help.short: The name of the Redis Enterprise cluster. Name must be 1-60 characters long. Allowed characters(A-Z, a-z, 0-9) and hyphen(-). There can be no leading nor trailing nor consecutive hyphens
The name of the Redis Enterprise database.
The name of the group of linked database resources. This should match the existing replication group name.

The resource IDs of the databases that are expected to be linked and included in the replication group. This parameter is used to validate that the linking is to the expected (unlinked) part of the replication group, if it is splintered.
Resource ID of a database resource to link with this database.
Properties to configure geo replication for this database.

description: Forcibly recreates an existing database on the specified cluster, and rejoins it to an existing replication group. **IMPORTANT NOTE:** All data in this database will be discarded, and the database will temporarily be unavailable while rejoining the replication group.
